'''Bren-Jules Rordan''' was a [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]]. He joined the [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] as a teenager and became an [[Observer]] before joining the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau's]] [[Surveillance (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|Surveillance]] branch. Rordan was not very bright or observant, but excelled at covering himself by passing the blame and telling his superiors what they wanted to hear. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he was assigned to [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]] and ran [[B. J. Rordan's Collectables]]. His employees were all employed by various other intelligence agencies vying for power in the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]].
